depth_export: Official source commit and checkpoint checksum verified; FP32 vs PyTorch and Q8 vs FP32 comparisons passed on four images.
browser_checks: Real bundled YOLO and metric depth; photo blue/red detection; negative background; save image; confidence; invalid photo recovery; mobile; depth toggle; failed model download and retry; checksum rejection and retry; simulated camera with depth; stop cancels held depth download; detection recovers after cancellation.
unit_checks: RGB normalization, central median, aspect ratio mapping, sparse/invalid/saturated depth, unavailable labels; worker timeout, retry, completion cleanup, cancellation and message errors.
limitations: Tests use composite images and simulated camera frames. Physical distance accuracy and phone-camera performance are unmeasured.
